title: VaaniCallExtractionSchema
description: Structured JSON schema for extraction from phone conversations by Vaani (AI Used Excavator Sales Agent). Missing or unmentioned values must strictly be null, never hallucinated.

caller_name.description: Explicit full or business name of the caller. Set to null if not stated.

callback_number.description: Phone number for callback or communication. If not stated, set to null.

whatsapp_number.description: Explicit WhatsApp number if confirmed by caller. If caller says WhatsApp is the same as calling number, use callback_number.

customer_type.description: Whether caller is looking to sell equipment ('seller'), buy equipment ('buyer'), or neither.

ownership_type.description: For sellers: whether caller is direct machine owner, broker/munim, or authorized agent.

machine_details.description: Details of the machine being sold (for sellers) or desired (for buyers).

model_year.description: Manufacturing or RTO registration year. Null if unstated.

running_hours.description: Hour meter reading in operating hours. Null if unstated.

application_history.description: Operational history: soil/earthwork ('mitti') vs stone quarry/breaker ('pahad').

machine_condition_summary.description: Brief verbal description of machine mechanical health given by caller.

location_city.description: City where machine is parked or where buyer requires delivery (e.g. 'Jaipur', 'Satara', 'Singrauli').

location_state.description: State where machine is located or required (e.g. 'Rajasthan', 'Madhya Pradesh', 'Maharashtra').

document_status.description: Legal/RTO status of vehicle registration and finance.

expected_price_inr.description: Parsed integer value in INR for seller asking price (e.g. 2500000).

budget_max_inr.description: Parsed integer value in INR for buyer maximum budget ceiling.

price_or_budget_raw.description: Raw verbatim spoken quote (e.g. '25 Lakh', '33-35 Lakh', '20 se 22 Lakh').

yard_visit_agreed.description: Whether buyer agreed to visit Jaipur yard for physical machine inspection.

yard_visit_schedule.description: Date or time agreed for physical inspection visit.

evidence_readiness.description: Status of digital asset exchange via WhatsApp.

photos_agreed.description: Whether caller agreed to send machine photos via WhatsApp.

running_video_agreed.description: Whether caller agreed to send a 30-second operational running video.

rc_copy_agreed.description: Whether seller agreed to share RC/NOC document photo.

lead_temperature.description: Deterministic sales priority tier based on qualification rules.

qualification_state.description: QUALIFIED only if target specification, price/budget, and location are fully captured.

next_action.description: Actionable next operational task for the sales team.

follow_up_required.description: True if an automated or human callback is needed.

follow_up_datetime.description: Promised callback date/time in ISO 8601 string or verbal descriptor.

call_notes.description: Concise summary of key customer requests, machine quirks, or deal notes.

dnc_requested.description: True if caller asked not to be contacted or requested number deletion.
